# Shopify

> > Shopify is a leading global commerce platform empowering businesses to sell online, in-person, and everywhere in between.

Shopify provides ecommerce solutions including Shopify POS, Shopify Payments, Shopify Admin, and tools for brand building, influencer marketing, and multi-channel selling. The platform serves merchants, partners, and developers with enterprise-grade security (PCI DSS compliant) and integrations with major marketplaces like Amazon and Etsy.

## Key Topics

- Shopify POS
- Shopify Payments
- Shopify Admin
- Platform comparisons (vs Amazon, Etsy, HostGator, Shopware)
- Ecommerce platform features
- Brand customization and building
- Multi-channel selling
- Payment processing
- PCI DSS compliance
- Remote work and careers
- Shopify Partner Program
- Influencer marketing (Shopify Collabs)
- Product photography
- Agentic commerce and AI
- Bug bounty program

## Platform & Core Products

- [Shopify POS - Tap to Pay on iPhone](https://www.shopify.com/pos/tap-to-pay-iphone): Tap to Pay on iPhone with Shopify POS for contactless mobile payments
- [Shopify POS for Jewelry Stores](https://www.shopify.com/pos/jewelry-store-pos): Shopify POS for jewelry stores with omnichannel and multi-location support
- [Shopify Collabs - Find Influencers](https://www.shopify.com/collabs/find-influencers): Shopify Collabs app for influencer marketing and affiliate partnerships
- [Shopify Partner Program](https://www.shopify.com/partners/service-partners): Shopify Partner Program for agencies, consultants, and service providers

## Platform Comparisons

- [Shopify vs Amazon](https://www.shopify.com/compare/shopify-vs-amazon): Platform comparison: Shopify vs Amazon for ecommerce and multi-channel
- [Shopify vs Etsy](https://www.shopify.com/compare/shopify-vs-etsy): Platform comparison: Shopify vs Etsy for brand customization and selling
- [Shopify vs HostGator](https://www.shopify.com/compare/shopify-vs-hostgator): Platform comparison: Shopify vs HostGator web hosting and ecommerce features
- [Shopify vs Shopware](https://www.shopify.com/compare/shopify-vs-shopware): Platform comparison: Shopify vs Shopware for performance and conversion
